<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="dWxqPjFzZptrv5Z-6mT3"> <mxGraphModel dx="3463" dy="1074" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title Traffic Timing Decision

autonumber

actor \"Launch Manager\" as LM
participant \"Health Monitor\" as Health
participant \"Logger\" as Logger
participant \"Analytics\" as Analytics
queue \"Snapshot Queue\" as Queue
participant \"Periodic RT Thread\" as RT
participant \"Traffic Data Receiver\" as Receiver
participant \"Decision Engine\" as Decision
participant \"Constraint Manager\" as Constraint
participant \"TimingPlan Publisher\" as Publisher
actor \"Traffic Signal Controller\" as FSM

note left of LM
Period = 2.5 s
end note
loop 

RT ->> Health : startReportHealth()
activate RT
activate Health

Health -> Health : recordStartTimestamp()
activate Health
Health -->> Health : recordStatus
deactivate Health

RT ->> Receiver : activateDecisionCycle()
activate Receiver

Receiver -> Queue : SnapshotRequest()
activate Queue
Queue -->> Receiver : TrafficSnapshot
deactivate Queue

Receiver -> Receiver : validateSnapshot()
activate Receiver
Receiver -->> Receiver : ValidationResult
deactivate Receiver


opt Snapshot valid

 Receiver ->> Decision : processTrafficMetrics(metrics)
 deactivate Receiver
 activate Decision

 Decision -> Decision : detectEmergency()
 activate Decision
 Decision -->> Decision : EmergencyStatus
 deactivate Decision

 alt Emergency detected

 Decision -> Decision : setEmergencyFlags()
 activate Decision
 Decision -->> Decision : TimingPlan
 deactivate Decision

 Decision ->> Publisher : TimingPlan(previousPlan, emergencyFlags)
 
 deactivate Decision 
 activate Publisher
 
 Publisher -> FSM : publishTimingPlan(TimingPlan)
 activate FSM
 FSM -->> Publisher : ACK / NACK
 deactivate FSM
 deactivate Publisher

 else Normal traffic

 activate Decision
 Decision -> Decision : calculateDemandScore()
 activate Decision
 Decision -->> Decision : TrafficDemandScore
 deactivate Decision

 Decision -> Decision : assignGreenTime()
 activate Decision
 Decision -->> Decision : DraftTimingPlan
 deactivate Decision

 Decision ->> Constraint : DraftTimingPlan
 
 deactivate Decision
 activate Constraint

 Constraint -> Constraint : applyTimingConstraints()
 activate Constraint
 Constraint -->> Constraint : AdjustedTimingPlan
 deactivate Constraint

 Constraint -> Constraint : validateCycleLength()
 activate Constraint
 Constraint -->> Constraint : ValidatedTimingPlan
 deactivate Constraint

 Constraint ->> Publisher : ValidatedTimingPlan
 deactivate Constraint

 activate Publisher
 Publisher -> FSM : publishTimingPlan(TimingPlan)
 activate FSM
 FSM -->> Publisher : ACK / NACK
 deactivate FSM
 deactivate Publisher

 end

deactivate Decision

end
RT ->> Health : decisionCycleFinished()
deactivate RT

Health -> Health : recordFinishTimestamp()
activate Health
Health -->> Health : recordStatus
deactivate Health

Health -> Health : calculateExecutionTime()
activate Health
Health -->> Health : executionTime
deactivate Health

Health -> Health : compareWithDeadline()
activate Health
Health -->> Health : deadlineStatus
deactivate Health

Health ->> LM : AliveNotification

 Health ->> Logger : logTimingData()
deactivate Health
 activate Logger

 
 Logger -> Logger : storeTimingData()


activate Logger
 Logger -->> Logger : LogData
 deactivate Logger
end

 Logger ->> Analytics : processLogData(LogData)
deactivate Logger
 activate Analytics

 Analytics -> Analytics : calculateStatistics()

activate Analytics
 Analytics -->> Analytics : BenchmarkData
deactivate Analytics

 deactivate Analytics
 

 deactivate RT





@enduml",
 "config": null
